Per our conversation, Redwood would like to offer Fluxly a limited Q4 "Accelerator" pilot to fast-track joint opportunity flow and get early revenue-share telemetry. High-level proposal attached (Partner_Promo_Term_Summary.pdf + commission_table_q4.xlsx). Key points: 

- Pilot term: 60 days starting on signature.
- Promo: One-time onboarding credit of $10k against first invoice for deals closed during pilot.
- Commission: 15% rev-share on pilot-sourced revenue; if partner remains active, 10% ongoing on renewal for 12 months.
- Lead registration: partner portal registration + first-touch registration window (5 business days). Registered leads get a 20% finder-override for the first qualified close.
- Exclusivity: none — we want to keep it open, but named-account protections can be discussed in parallel.

Rina — answers inline below. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

> 1) Lead registration timing
We accept registration in two ways: (A) pre-outreach registration in the partner portal (preferred), or (B) retroactive registration within 5 business days of first outreach with supporting context. We will require an initial intake form + email header evidence for (B). Aim is to avoid turf disputes while being pragmatic for co-sell.

> 2) Attribution
For this pilot: registered leads (via portal or retroactive with evidence) get priority attribution. If a lead is already an active inbound opportunity in HubSpot logged prior to registration, we’ll run a simple adjudication: registration timestamp > HubSpot first-touch timestamp = partner attribution. We will provide a small adjudication table in the redline.

> 3) Named-account carveouts
Yes — send the list. We can agree to a 30-day notification window where Redwood pauses outbound motions to those named accounts while we sync GTM plans, but we can’t offer broad market exclusivity for the pilot.

Next steps: Ben (sales ops) will send a concise addendum with registration rules and a redline. If that looks good, we’ll route to DocuSign and enable a partner code that will auto-apply the onboarding credit.

Thanks — looping Ben to kick off the addendum.

--
Soojin
